column.name: summary
column.value: Grouping code by what it does instead of by what kind of class it is.

column.name: content
column.value:
Putting the entity, repository, and service for posts in one package means the repository can stay package-private.
Controllers have to go through the service, which keeps database access in one place.

column.name: summary
column.value: Why final fields and constructors beat @Autowired on fields.

column.name: content
column.value:
With constructor injection, dependencies are explicit and the object is always fully initialised.
It also makes classes easy to create in plain unit tests.

column.name: content
column.value:
Hibernate skips dirty checking for read-only transactions, and the JDBC connection is flagged as read-only.
Write methods override it with a plain @Transactional.

column.name: summary
column.value: A shared layout without an extra layout library.

column.name: content
column.value:
th:fragment defines a reusable piece of a page and th:replace pulls it in.
Fragment parameters let each page set its own title and active navigation link.
